tax.text: Hernandez supports raising taxes on billionaires and large corporations to fund services such as health care, housing, and child care.
tax.quote: Raising taxes on billionaires and the largest corporations is a necessity.

schools.text: Hernandez supports increasing funding for district public schools and directing public education dollars to them.
schools.quote: Public dollars should go to public schools.

safety.text: Hernandez opposes adding police or armed guards to campuses and supports mental-health professionals and community-based alternatives.
safety.quote: We need real community-based solutions to handle real community problems – like trained mental health professionals being the first on the scene when someone is having a mental health crisis.

sentencing.text: Hernandez supports diverting people from the criminal legal system and funding alternatives to policing and incarceration.
sentencing.quote: Making sure we divert as many people, especially TGI people, as possible from the criminal legal system is a must for me.

immigration.text: Hernandez supports abolishing ICE, protecting immigrants from deportation, and expanding access to immigration legal counsel.
immigration.quote: To aid our neighbors, I support increasing funds to help those facing deportation gain access to legal counsel.

health.text: Hernandez supports universal health care coverage for all Californians through CalCare.
health.quote: What California needs is CalCare - universal healthcare guaranteed to all Californians.

energy.text: Hernandez opposes new oil and gas leases, supports renewable energy investments, and opposes oil and gas subsidies.
energy.quote: I will always support measures that aim to invest in renewable and sustainable energy, and against corporate subsidies for the oil and gas industries.

housing.text: Zbur supported making affordable housing easier to build but opposed SB 79 because he said it did not adequately protect neighborhoods.
housing.quote: There was one bill that I felt did that in a way that didn’t protect our neighborhoods as well as it should.

safety.text: Rick Chavez Zbur supports reducing police violence and using mental health and addiction professionals to address the causes of crime.
safety.quote: Rick supports a smart approach to reducing crime like reforms to reduce police violence, increase gun safety, and employ qualified professionals who can offer mental health and addiction services to fight the root causes of crime.

abortion.text: Authored legislation restricting responses to subpoenas seeking information about legally protected abortion and reproductive care and said people should be able to seek lawful care without risking their privacy or safety.
abortion.quote: No one should have to fear that seeking lawful medical care in the state of California could put their privacy and their safety at risk,” he told the Assembly Judiciary Committee at a hearing last week.

energy.text: Authored AB39, the Local Electrification Planning Act, which the governor signed into law.
energy.quote: AB 39 by Assemblymember Rick Chavez Zbur (D-Los Angeles) – General plans: Local Electrification Planning Act.
